'''Iziz Comm''' was a news company in the [[Onderon/Legends|Onderonian]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Onderon Civil War]]. [[Unidentified Human journalist (Onderon)|One of]] their [[Journalist/Legends|journalists]] was apprehended by the [[Onderonian military]] but was exonerated by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Meetra Surik]], although it was later reported that authorities believed the journalist was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] responsible for an explosion at the [[South Quarter Mining Refinery]].
